raw_text:
Episode No. 5
Logline - At the reading of Savitri's will, Nandini makes her final move, and Rhea must choose between her mother and the truth.
Continuity Notes
* The confirmed DNA report (blue folder) is in the lawyer's hands.
* Rhea wears no engagement ring from this episode onward.
* Savitri is in a wheelchair after collapsing off-screen.

SCENE 1 | INT. MALHOTRA MANSION - LIBRARY - DAY | 00:00 --> 00:52
CAMERA: Overhead shot of the family seated in a semicircle around the lawyer.
00:00 --> 00:05  ACTION  The lawyer, ARJUN MEHTA, opens a blue folder. The room holds its breath.
00:05 --> 00:11  ARJUN  The repeated DNA test confirms it. Maya is Meera Malhotra's daughter. Ninety-nine point nine percent.
00:11 --> 00:15  ACTION  Savitri reaches out and takes Maya's hand. Nandini doesn't blink.
00:15 --> 00:21  ARJUN  Under the will, the controlling stake of Malhotra Industries passes to Meera's heir.
00:21 --> 00:26  NANDINI  Then the will is outdated. Maa signed a new one last month.
00:26 --> 00:31  ACTION  Nandini lays a document on the table. Savitri's signature glints at the bottom.
00:31 --> 00:36  SAVITRI  I signed no such thing.
00:36 --> 00:42  NANDINI  You signed a great many things, Maa, when you were on your medication.
00:42 --> 00:47  ACTION  Arjun examines the paper. His expression darkens. It looks legitimate.
00:47 --> 00:52  ARJUN  If this holds up, Maya inherits nothing. Nandini controls the company.

SCENE 2 | INT. MALHOTRA MANSION - LIBRARY - CONTINUOUS | 00:52 --> 01:44
CAMERA: Slow push in on Rhea, isolating her from the room.
00:52 --> 00:57  ACTION  Rhea stands. Her hand goes to the bare spot where her ring used to be.
00:57 --> 01:02  RHEA  It doesn't hold up. Because I watched you forge it, Mumma.
01:02 --> 01:06  ACTION  Nandini turns slowly toward her daughter.
01:06 --> 01:11  NANDINI  Sit down, Rhea. You don't know what you're saying.
01:11 --> 01:18  RHEA  I know you used Dadi's signature stamp. I know you chained the door the night of the fire.
01:18 --> 01:23  ACTION  Gasps. Vikram steps in front of Maya without thinking.
01:23 --> 01:29  RHEA  And I have it on tape. Your voice. Telling me he was "a contract."
01:29 --> 01:34  ACTION  Rhea plays the recording. Nandini's voice fills the library.
01:34 --> 01:39  NANDINI  You'd destroy your own mother for her? For a waitress?
01:39 --> 01:44  RHEA  No. For the sister you made me hate.

SCENE 3 | EXT. MALHOTRA MANSION - DRIVEWAY - DAY | 01:44 --> 02:32
CAMERA: Wide, police lights reflecting off the fountain.
01:44 --> 01:50  ACTION  Police cars line the driveway. Two officers lead Nandini out in handcuffs.
01:50 --> 01:55  NANDINI  This isn't over, Maya. You have no idea who pulled you out of that fire.
01:55 --> 02:00  ACTION  Maya freezes. Nandini is pushed into the car.
02:00 --> 02:06  MAYA  What did she mean? Who saved me?
02:06 --> 02:12  ACTION  Savitri wheels forward. She looks at Maya, then at the gates, guilt written across her face.
02:12 --> 02:18  SAVITRI  There is one more secret in this family, child. And it is mine.
02:18 --> 02:24  ACTION  A motorbike stops at the gates. A rider in a black helmet watches them.
02:24 --> 02:32  ACTION  The rider lifts the visor. It is a woman, older, with Maya's eyes. Meera. Alive.
